prompt: Our NestJS payment service verifies every incoming gateway webhook with an HMAC-SHA256 signature before crediting the order — but production has started rejecting genuine gateway events intermittently with 401 Unauthorized, while the exact same payloads always pass when QA hand-signs them in their local test harness. Money-affecting events are being silently dropped. Below is the signature guard, the controller, and the bootstrap exactly as they run today: walk through the code, tell me why real gateway events are failing verification while hand-signed ones succeed, and how you'd fix it.
